camera.shot_scale_bias: low-angle shots looking up, cut against long held two-shots

lens.dof: moderate focus that keeps both faces in a two-shot readable

lighting.practicals: light is motivated and slightly overexposed on skin

rules: a long unbroken two-shot across a table
an insert of feet, a boot, a car boot from below
composition.movement_of_subject: people sit and talk at length before anything happens

sound.ambience_bias: diner clatter, traffic, a jukebox in another room

music.instrumentation: A surf-rock guitar with driving drums

must_include: the camera looks up at the subject from near floor level
the conversation runs long before the action arrives

notes: Low angles, long talky two-shots, saturated warm colour. Stillness is held until it breaks.
